cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Join Me
cards.instruction: Recruit someone into a secret plan.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Take Denise for coffee while I put up the leaving-party decorations. Don't say 'we need you out of the office.'

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She won't go until this spreadsheet balances.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You've added the totals row twice. Remove the second one and tell her the figures are ready.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Then she'll want to stay and check them herself.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Send her the corrected copy to read over coffee. The coffee is the invitation; the word 'distraction' must remain inside your head.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 specifies nonrevealing cover, A3 diagnoses duplicate totals and A5 corrects B separation of checking work from coffee with clipped secrecy guidance.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 balancing obstacle causes A3 precise fix; B4 insistence on checking causes A5 sending the work along with the diversion.

relationship.evidence: B2 and B4 protect the plausibility of getting Denise away, supplying useful obstacles.

heightening.evidence: A5 turns B4 checking need into the cover itself while retaining the actual surprise objective.

specificity.evidence: A1 decorations and coffee, A3 corrected spreadsheet and B4 review demand form a coherent office plan.

brevityWit.evidence: A5 secrecy warning is an instruction to the accomplice with a concrete purpose, not a description for a reviewer.
